appName.description: The name of the application (must be a valid DNS-1123 label, as it is used as a Kubernetes namespace name)

repoURL.description: The Git repository URL for the application (e.g. https://github.com/dyegoe/sample-app). Accepts https:// or, though deprecated by Kargo, ssh:// and SCP-style (git@host:path) URLs

imageURL.description: The container image repository (registry/path, no scheme like http(s):// or oci://, and no tag/digest)

interval.description: The Warehouse's reconciliation interval (e.g. 5m0s, 1h). Defaults to 5m0s when unset

gitItemPath.description: The path to the 1Password item containing the application's Git repository credentials to be used by Kargo. 1Password item must have the following fields: 'username', 'password', and 'repoURL'

imageItemPath.description: The path to the 1Password item containing the application's container image credentials if the image is private. 1Password item must have the following fields: 'username', 'password', and 'repoURL'
